prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: an NHS nurse pauses to speak with an older patient in a quiet hospital corridor, a human image about public services, trust and sensitive data.
Scene/backdrop: real British hospital corridor with soft clinical architecture and a privacy curtain, no visible forms or monitors.
Style/medium: respectful documentary photojournalism, candid interaction, natural expressions, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, nurse and patient in profile at human eye level, corridor softly receding.
Lighting/mood: cool daylight softened by warm practical light and a faint red reflection, calm and thoughtful.
Color palette: warm near-black shadows, muted hospital neutrals, natural skin, small red accent.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark; patient privacy respected.
Avoid: paperwork, screens, office, robots, alarmist mood, staged stock photography.
